blocks.text: A river in the northeastern Japanese prefecture of Akita swelled and overflowed on Wednesday prompting Japan’s weather agency to issue an emergency flood warning, its highest-level alert, and urge residents to take measures to ensure their safety. Water was found overflowing near the left bank of the Koyoshi River in Yurihonjo, Japan’s land ministry said.
